title: General W4 recovery beyond path and equal-star slices
objective: Prove the general W4 shifted-inverse Schur-recovery inequality, or isolate its exact aggregate replacement, starting with a four-vertex path, a sign-frustrated cycle, and an unequal-weight degree-three star.
acceptance_checks: Reconstructs the audited matching, weighted-three-path, and equal-star slices before generalizing them.
Treats at least the four-path, a frustrated cycle, and an unequal-weight star analytically rather than by a parameter grid alone.
Retains the anisotropic child surplus and does not replace it by the known-false spectral-only bound.

Any positive result states exactly whether it proves C052's single W4 edge or only a structured subfamily, and explicitly records that stable propagation through all later depths remains before C051 and hence C050.
No W4-only result may report C051 or C050 as proved, refuted, or otherwise resolved.

required_differences: Advance beyond the already audited matching, weighted-three-path, and equal-star blocks.
Locate the first failed Schur edge before changing the Bellman state.
Distinguish a proof of C051 from the weaker target C050.
forbidden_methods: spectral-only replacement of the anisotropic child surplus
parameter-grid evidence presented as a general matrix inequality
treating C051 as necessary for C050
required_controls: known matching and weighted-three-path positive slices
